title: NIPO-weekpeilingen cumulatief vanaf 1989
authors: Steinmetz Archive * Amsterdam, Nederlands instituut voor de publieke opinie en het marktonderzoek,  NIPO * Amsterdam (primary investigator)
descriptions: Cumulative file of the background variables of NIPO's weekly opinion surveys. Voting behaviour / voting intention / party adherence / left-right scaling / sex / age / income / denomination / location. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ politics/ religion/ organizational membership
